other_conditions: The student must not have availed similar benefits from any other Government or Institution for the same purpose
The student must have secured admission to a higher education course in a recognized institution in India or abroad

The course of study must be in Management, Integrated Law, Engineering, or Medicine in institutions established by Acts of Parliament, State Legislature, or recognized by the relevant statutory bodies
The scheme is targeted at economically weaker background students
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10 lakh educational loan with the borrower paying only 1% interest, the remaining interest subsidised by the Government of Odisha.
